HEMO04|FR-12.old:
a Start **semi-recumbent (trunk at 45°)**, not supine — this also
recruits blood from the splanchnic circulation, not just the legs.
Use the bed to tilt; do not touch the patient (pain or arousal
confounds).
b About 300 mL of the patient's own blood (your notes give a range
starting at 250 mL); effect within about 60–90 s; fully reversed on
returning to baseline.
c **Cardiac output or stroke volume in real time** (pulse contour,
echo VTI, oesophageal Doppler) — not blood pressure. A rise of
**10% or more** is positive; with end-tidal CO2, a rise of 5% or
more. Re-measure after returning to baseline.
d Spontaneous breathing, arrhythmias, low tidal volume.
HEMO04|FR-12.new:
a Start **semi-recumbent (trunk at 45°)**, not supine — this also
recruits blood from the splanchnic circulation, not just the legs.
Use the bed to tilt; do not touch the patient (pain or arousal
confounds).
b About 300 mL of the patient's own blood (your notes give a range
starting at 250 mL); effect begins within seconds and is **maximal at about 30–90 s**, then drifts back; fully reversed on
returning to baseline.
c **Cardiac output or stroke volume in real time** (pulse contour,
echo VTI, oesophageal Doppler) — not blood pressure. A rise of
**10% or more** is positive; with end-tidal CO2, a rise of 5% or
more. Re-measure after returning to baseline.
d Spontaneous breathing, arrhythmias, low tidal volume.
HEMO04|FR-12.why: Maximal PLR effect is at 30-90 s, not 60-90 s - the exact number GT8 Q88 tests. Source: LITFL Passive Leg Raise (https://litfl.com/passive-leg-raise) and Oh's ICM 9e p744.
